engagement_background.objective: Generate $240K–$470K in cost savings through enterprise-wide strategic sourcing, while maintaining or enhancing service quality and leveraging Savida Health’s collective purchasing power; deliver quick-hit savings by year-end 2024 and complete all sourcing waves by March 2025.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Ten indirect/clinical spend categories totaling roughly $5.3 M in baseline spend (EMR, employee benefits, lab & medical supplies, small parcel, IT hardware, telecom, office supplies, commercial print, waste). Low-spend/low-opportunity categories may be dropped as better data emerges; direct patient-care services outside these categories are out of scope.
constraints_challenges: Supplier non-responsiveness to data requests and RFQs
Risk of uncoordinated 'side conversations' with suppliers undermining negotiations
Potential pushback or limited availability from key Savida stakeholders for data and approvals
Incumbent supplier sensitivities and resistance during competitive sourcing
Need to show measurable savings quickly to meet PE timeline (quick hits by end-2024, project finish by March 2025)
Incomplete internal usage data, requiring line-item details to be requested from high-spend suppliers

procurement_environment.data_availability: Basic AP/PO and invoice data exist at unit level; contracts are held locally. Line-item usage often not centrally stored, so supplier-provided data is required to build baselines.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Data scattered across multiple units with inconsistent formats; gaps expected where suppliers fail to supply historical usage within 6-week window.
